Pre-launching 🚀

VGN Wincrest Towers – Signature Luxury Homes in Guindy!

Book an Apartment and get 10 GMS Gold Coin absolutely FREE!
Offer valid for the next 50 Bookings only

We’re thrilled to offer VGN Wincrest Towers 2 and 3BHK Homes at a special Pre-launch price of ₹11,999/- per sq.ft. for 2 BHK and Rs 14,999/- per sq.ft for 3 BHK. Apartments ranging from 1,029 sq.ft to 1,354 sq.ft. VGN Wincrest Towers is conveniently located in the heart of Guindy, opposite the Hilton Hotel and just 500m from Ekkattuthangal Metro Station.

Enjoy easy access to the airport, malls, schools, hospitals, IT offices, and more. A 40,000 sq.ft centrally air-conditioned clubhouse across 7 floors with a rooftop swimming pool, barbecue deck, badminton courts, banquet halls, and more...

Project Highlights:

✅ Centrally Air-Conditioned Clubhouse
✅ Exclusive Multi-level Car Parking Block
✅ Home Automation
✅ Rooftop Swimming Pool
✅ Indoor Forest Lounge
✅ Lobby Access Control
✅ Digital Video Doorbell
✅ Barbecue Deck & More

Don’t miss this exclusive pre-launch offer to book VGN Wincrest Towers at  ₹11,999/- per sq.ft.
